title: Service Book
description: A log of every service and repair on the car (date, km from the odometer, type, notes, cost, workshop), and the car's details: model, VIN, total km, and RCA, CASCO, Rovinieta and ITP with days left; and a guide to MG Flasher's Custom Code menu. Typed on the app's own touch keyboard.
